name: loopy
description: Complete autonomous work with evidence of correctness, preservation, and independent use.

interface.shortDescription: Finish work others can understand and use
interface.longDescription: Use Loopy to finish substantial work with evidence that it is correct, preserves important constraints, and lets its intended user act without the production conversation. Fresh evaluators try real tasks where independent use matters; supported findings drive corrections and sufficient evidence ends the loop.
defaultPrompt: Use Loopy to complete this task and verify its intended user can use the result without this chat.
Use Loopy to preserve important constraints, verify correctness, and test the result through a fresh user's task.
